EXPLANATION: The dominant Raman line at 2114 cm⁻¹ fits a C≡C stretch of a terminal alkyne (nitrile C≡N would appear higher, ≈2220–2260 cm⁻¹ and is absent). Only candidates 1 and 8 contain an alkyne without a nitrile; of these, peak 1047 cm⁻¹ (typical C-O stretch) and 1170 cm⁻¹ (C-O/C-C-O bending of alcohols) require an oxygenated moiety, which candidate 1 (t-butyn-2-ol) provides while candidate 8 is purely hydrocarbon. The strong C-H stretches at 2935/2879 cm⁻¹ and alkyl bending at 1454 cm⁻¹ match the branched alkyl groups in 1. Therefore candidate 1 best accounts for the observed peaks.
